findings.oracle: Real multi-file unified diff fed to _estimate_tokens; tiktoken cl100k_base (a different, independent BPE tokenizer) is the oracle; asserts estimate/reference ratio in [0.6,1.8] (real 1.3, while a corrupted len//10 gives 0.39 -> RED), plus empty-string==0 and strict monotonicity in input length.

Real google.genai ServerError(503)/ClientError(400)/'too large'/stdlib ConnectionError instances raised by a concrete (non-MagicMock) Gemini-surface client through the real _count_tokens; asserts result == independent _estimate_tokens(text) for each exact text; adds success-path exact-API-total (4242) and an uncaught KeyError-propagates test proving the except set is specific, not blanket.

Deterministic virtual clock replaces time.monotonic/time.sleep (the OS timing primitives, not the function); with interval=0.5 and elapsed=0.1, asserts the function sleeps exactly 0.4s within 1e-9 and advances _last_count_time to 1000.4; second test asserts zero sleeps once the interval has fully elapsed. No wall-clock tolerance.

Real Windows PE driven through execute_strings_extraction at floors 6 and 12; backend-reported 'length' field is the independent oracle; asserts min(low)>=6 and min(high)>=12 (real min==6 and ==12), that a record sits exactly on the low floor (binding constraint), and that 233 sub-12 strings present at floor 6 are all removed at floor 12. A no-op min_length filter would yield min<6 -> RED.
